metadata.case_name: FARMAN KHAN v. LAU KAI HONG AND LAU SIU YUK T/A SHUN SUM ENGINEERING CO (A FIRM)

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: cleaning worker, warehouse attendant and indoor decoration worker (also security guard, car park attendant suggested)

source: Based on the information from the medical documents, the X Ray and MRI findings, it is very likely that Mr. Khan suffers from musculotendinous strain of neck muscle and traumatic protruded L5-S1 disc of lumbar spine. The protruded L5-S1 disc caused compression of left side of nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: soft tissue contusion injury over the back and pelvis
source: The diagnosis was soft tissue contusion injury over the back and pelvis.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: prolapsed / protruded intervertebral disc L5/S1 on left side with compression on nerve root
source: MRI spine on 18 January 2008 showed prolapsed intervertebral disc L5/S1 on left side with compression on nerve root.

Based on the information from the medical documents, the X Ray and MRI findings, it is very likely that Mr. Khan suffers from musculotendinous strain of neck muscle and traumatic protruded L5-S1 disc of lumbar spine. The protruded L5-S1 disc caused compression of left side of nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

source: X Ray and MRI also revealed degenerative cervical and lumbar spine. They were pre-existing as a result of natural degeneration.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: psychiatric disorder: Adjustment Disorder, unspecified subtype and Major Depressive Episode, moderate
source: The psychiatric diagnoses are Adjustment Disorder, unspecified subtype and Major Depressive Episode, moderate.
The psychiatric disorders are the direct result of the injury on 10th October 2006.
Certain degree of permanent psychiatric impairment is expected and is in the region of 5 to 10%.
He sustained multiple body abrasions plus contusions and visited A&E TKOH and was discharged after primary treatment.

manifestations.description: diffused tenderness over back with muscle spasm
range of back movement limited by pain
pain over both hips and knees and limited their range of motion
wheelchair use at first outpatient clinic follow up on 5 December 2006
diffused severe pain over multiple parts of body
low back pain and left leg pain, weakness and numbness
needed a stick and friend's support in walking; could manage only less than 5 minutes
psychological fear of construction site environment limiting return to pre-injury occupation

treatments_future: rehabilitation up to three months after operation

losses.description: Unable to resume his pre-injury job (construction site work); cannot resume pre-injury job even after surgical treatment according to experts
Needed a stick and friend's support in walking and could manage only less than 5 minutes
